title: Satmar Philanthropist Hosts Sheva Brachos
body: Satmar Rebbe attends sheva brachos hosted by philanthropist Mr. Yoeli Landau in Williamsburg, honoring the wedding of his grandson. The event dedicated to orphans of the Satmar community.

title: Eidah Hachareidis Bans Concerts
body: The Eidah Hachareidis' Badatz issued a public notice warning against "Ervei Shira" or concerts, citing a breach in communal standards of kedushah and tznius. The proclamation expresses concern over the rapid expansion of these events.
